# Fonrex Documentation

> Official technical documentation for Fonrex — Open-source financial data infrastructure API.

Fonrex provides high-performance self-hosted financial data pipelines, TimescaleDB time-series storage, real-time WebSocket streaming, valuation & DCF engines, technical indicators, and multi-provider consensus monitoring.

## Core & Getting Started

- [Introduction](/docs/intro.md): High-level introduction to Fonrex financial data infrastructure.
- [Installation](/docs/getting-started/installation.md): Step-by-step setup guide for local and production environments.
- [Configuration](/docs/getting-started/configuration.md): System parameters, database credentials, and environment flags.
- [First API Call](/docs/getting-started/first-api-call.md): Making your first authenticated REST API request.
- [Docker Compose](/docs/getting-started/docker-compose.md): Multi-container deployment with PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, and Redis.

## API Reference

- [Assets & Listings](/docs/api-reference/assets.md): Tickers, ISINs, exchanges, asset metadata, and search endpoints.
- [Fundamentals](/docs/api-reference/fundamentals.md): Income statements, balance sheets, cash flow series, and financial ratios.
- [Historical Prices](/docs/api-reference/historical.md): OHLCV time-series queries, resampling, and intraday data endpoints.
- [Realtime Streaming](/docs/api-reference/realtime.md): WebSocket and Server-Sent Events (SSE) live data stream specs.
- [Technical Indicators](/docs/api-reference/technical-indicators.md): Moving averages, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, and custom calculations.
- [Valuation & DCF Engine](/docs/api-reference/valuation-dcf.md): Discounted Cash Flow, WACC estimation, and intrinsic value endpoints.
- [News & Sentiment](/docs/api-reference/news.md): Financial news aggregation, article extraction, and sentiment scoring.
- [Health & Monitoring](/docs/api-reference/monitoring.md): Provider consensus status, validation logs, and system health checks.
- [Specialized Data](/docs/api-reference/specialized.md): Crypto, Foreign Exchange (FX), macroeconomics, and commodities endpoints.

## Guides & Tutorials

- [Import Assets](/docs/guides/import-assets.md): Bulk asset onboarding and ticker symbol mapping workflows.
- [Ingest Historical Data](/docs/guides/ingest-historical-data.md): Pipeline setup for historical data backfilling.
- [Configure Realtime](/docs/guides/configure-realtime.md): Realtime websocket subscription and multiplexing guide.
- [Backtesting with Zipline](/docs/guides/backtesting-zipline.md): Integrating Fonrex data pipelines into Zipline and Python backtesters.
- [Adding Data Providers](/docs/guides/adding-providers.md): Implementing custom provider adapters with hexagonal architecture.

## Architecture & System Design

- [System Overview](/docs/architecture/overview.md): High-level system topology, domain boundaries, and data flows.
- [Hexagonal Architecture](/docs/architecture/hexagonal.md): Ports & Adapters design pattern, domain isolation, and interface specs.
- [Data Model & Schema](/docs/architecture/data-model.md): PostgreSQL relational schemas and TimescaleDB hypertables design.
- [Database Migrations](/docs/architecture/migrations.md): Alembic migration policies, schema versioning, and zero-downtime rules.
- [Concurrency & Locking](/docs/architecture/concurrency.md): Async IO concurrency, Redis locks, rate limiters, and job queues.

## Data Providers

- [Providers Overview](/docs/providers/overview.md): Supported market data, fundamentals, and news providers list.
- [Fundamentals Providers](/docs/providers/fundamentals-providers.md): SEC EDGAR, Yahoo Finance, FMP, and custom adapters.
- [News Providers](/docs/providers/news-providers.md): NewsAPI, Benzinga, SEC RSS feeds, and crawler setup.
- [Adding Custom Provider](/docs/providers/adding-custom-provider.md): Step-by-step developer guide for adding new provider modules.

## Monitoring & Reliability

- [Validation Layer](/docs/monitoring/validation-layer.md): Data sanity verification, anomaly detection, and consensus rules.
- [Canary Monitor](/docs/monitoring/canary-monitor.md): Automated synthetic API probes and provider availability tracking.
- [Alerts & Webhooks](/docs/monitoring/alerts.md): Configuring Slack, Discord, email, and custom webhook alerts.

- [Docker Deployment](/docs/deployment/docker.md): Production Docker setup, container hardening, and multi-stage builds.
- [Environment Variables](/docs/deployment/environment-variables.md): Complete reference of all configurable ENV parameters.
- [Database Migrations Deployment](/docs/deployment/database-migrations.md): Production database deployment and rollback procedures.
- [Production Checklist](/docs/deployment/production-checklist.md): Hardening, backups, health checks, and go-live verification.

## Contributing & Project Rules

## Complete Documentation Dump

There are two ways to access the LLM-friendly documentation:

* [llms.txt](/llms.txt) is essentially a sitemap, listing all the pages in the documentation.

* [llms-docs.txt](/llms-docs.txt) contains the general documentation (may exceed the context window of your LLM).

* [llms-api.txt](/llms-api.txt) contains the API documentation (may exceed the context window of your LLM).

* [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt) contains the entire documentation (may exceed the context window of your LLM).

!!! info
    In addition, you can access the Markdown source files of the documentation by appending `.md` to the URL
    of any page.
